title: Integrate PR #455 review follow-ups (custody economics, adoption-review repair, dice gate)
description:
Integration parent for the three PR #455 post-merge review follow-ups:

- eshyra-4ygd (P1): sold-item 'returned' basis bypasses sale-proceeds reversal (economic dupe loop)
- eshyra-eks3 (P2): migration-0018 oversized-stack reviews with quantity <=100 permanently unresolvable
- eshyra-2n3n (P2): numeric-conservation gate accepts family-only dice matches, hiding modifier drift

See those beads for full defect analysis with file/line references.

## Supervisor design decisions

- eshyra-4ygd: selling never credits the wallet inside removeItem — proceeds are a separate, unlinked model-initiated currency event — so a 'sale-reversed' basis cannot deterministically compute a refund. Fix is therefore: restrict 'returned' to lost custody; sold rows must use 'repurchased' with its existing atomic exact-denomination payment (a rescinded sale = repurchase at the refunded price). No schema change needed. A payment-free gift-back basis stays unsupported absent a new decision.
- eshyra-eks3: new migration reclassifies oversized-stack reviews whose inventory quantity is <= 100 to malformed-evidence (discard-evidence path works and preserves raw evidence). 0018 stays untouched.
- eshyra-2n3n: exact normalized dice tokens both directions; family tolerance removed; token-scoped exceptions with source-backed rationale for the (measured) 3 current family-only matches across robe-of-useful-items and staff-of-striking, adjudicated per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md.

## Acceptance criteria

1. reacquire_item rejects sold+returned; lost+returned and sold+repurchased(+payment) still work; tests updated without weakening economic guarantees; tool schema/description and list_recoverable_items basis filtering consistent.
2. New migration reclassifies impossible oversized-stack reviews; genuine oversized rows (>100) unaffected; regression test proves the previously-permanent quarantine becomes resolvable.
3. Conservation gate requires exact dice tokens; scoped exceptions carry rationale; no weakened expectations; gate still fails on a synthetic dropped/invented modifier.
4. npm run verify:worktree passes on the integration branch.

## Coordination

MIGRATION NUMBERING: branch eshyra-geny (PR #457 follow-ups, in flight) also adds migration 0022. Whichever PR merges second must renumber its migration before merge — the runner enforces contiguous 1..N. Supervisor handles this at integration/rebase time.

Work lands via child dispatch branches merged into branch eshyra-<this-bead>; single PR to main. Close the three defect beads when the PR merges.
